mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees with overcast conditions at Verona Community Park. Under the full moon, temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain predicted.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, activities include trivia at The Bogey Factory and pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Main Street Trick or Treat this Thursday.

In a report covering October 18 to October 25, officers noted an incident on Monday, October 19, where a 49-year-old Verona man was taken into custody on an active arrest warrant during a traffic stop for a suspended license.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10:00 PM, so stop by soon to enjoy your treat.
